d: To assist in the coordination and write-up of public relations materials, CSR programs documentation, and ESG reporting inputs across print, broadcast, and online media, ensuring consistency of the company identity and supporting the company's reputation amongst customers, government stakeholders, media, and the public.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Journalism, Public Relations, Social Sciences or any other relevant field
Proficiency in English and Arabic languages
Master’s degree in Business Administration, Journalism, Public Relations, Social Sciences or any other relevant field
Minimum of 2 years of experience in Communications, PR, Marketing, etc.
In this role, you will support our PR initiatives to enhance brand reputation and foster strong relationships with key stakeholders.
You will support Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) programs that align with our values and contribute positively to the communities we serve.

Additional ly, you will support and advance our Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) commitments, ensuring sustainable business practices and transparent reporting that meet stakeholder expectations.
Public Relations : Demonstrated ability to support communication strategies that enhance company reputation and stakeholder engagement.
Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG): Strong understanding of ESG principles and experience implementing sustainable business practices.
Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR): Proven track record in executing CSR initiatives that align with organizational values and community impact goals.
r: Monitor media coverage and public sentiment across print, digital, and broadcast channels, and prepare periodic reports highlighting coverage trends, reputation indicators, and potential reputational risks.
Assist in coordinating responses to media inquiries and support preparation of structured responses in alignment with corporate communication guidelines.

Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure public relations messaging is consistent with corporate positioning, communication guidelines, CSR governance frameworks, and internal approval procedures.

Assist in planning and execution of CSR initiatives, community programs, and social development projects aligned with organizational priorities, coordinating with external partners, NGOs, community organizations, and government entities and maintaining related documentation.

Track and report progress and performance indicators of media engagement, CSR participation, and ESG program implementation to assess social impact, stakeholder engagement, and alignment with national development priorities.
Assist in implementing ESG initiatives and maintaining records related to sustainability activities, environmental programs, and social responsibility projects.

Coordinate with internal departments to collect and compile the data and ESG-related information required for internal reporting, CSR and ESG performance reporting, and group-level sustainability disclosures.

Support preparation of periodic CSR and ESG reports, presentations, and communication materials summarizing PR activities and program progress for review by the reporting manager and for internal and external stakeholders.
Coordinate publicity and awareness campaigns for CSR initiatives in collaboration with communications and branding teams.
Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance communication processes, CSR program delivery, and ESG reporting practices.
